## Objective
- Create a complete, playable 3D MMO/RPG-inspired browser game with a Genshin/Wuthering-style fantasy presentation.

## Requirements
- 3D open exploration aesthetic.
- Playable movement and combat.
- No clarifying questions; reasonable assumptions allowed.

## Decisions
- Built a single-page Three.js experience named “Echoes of Aether — A Verdant Reach.”
- Used an original stylized fantasy world rather than copying specific characters or assets.
- Included a quest system, enemies, XP, levels, health, waystone interaction, abilities, minimap, and cinematic intro.
- Assumed the project should run as a static browser app.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the full static game UI and 3D scene in `index.html`.
- Implemented terrain, trees, rocks, flowers, grasses, hills, sky islands, sun, ruins, player character, enemies, wisps, and lighting.
- Implemented WASD movement, camera-relative controls, mouse camera turning, attacks, dash, area burst, enemy AI, health, XP, leveling, quest progress, and waystone healing.
- Added responsive desktop/mobile HUD, intro overlay, minimap, controls, and toast notifications.
- Installed Chromium and launched the app at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Verified the page rendered a canvas and UI and captured `/tmp/opencode/latest.jpg`.

### Active
- Fixing and validating the final visual/CSS behavior.

### Blocked
- Final visual details need browser reload verification after a recent CSS syntax correction.

1. Reload the app in the browser and capture a fresh 1280×800 JPEG.

3. Test movement and combat after clicking “ENTER THE MEADOW.”

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/XD/XD/index.html`: Main and only application file containing UI, scene, gameplay, and styles.
- `/tmp/opencode/latest.jpg`: Latest viewport screenshot for visual verification.

## Important Context
- The project is uncommitted and currently consists of the new `index.html`.
- The game depends on Three.js loaded from `https://unpkg.com/three@0.161.0/build/three.module.js`.
- The app currently runs via a local static server on port `3002`.
